identity.motif: C-F, E-F-G-Ab: a leap and a leading-tone flick that climbs a third each bar
identity.relation_to_thorns: Same palette with heavier kit (backbeat, gallop); F not C minor, 138 BPM, rising sequences instead of Thorns' circling phrases.

key: F harmonic minor; Neapolitan G-flat and a chromatic minor-chord climb
mood: Fire boss: an ember cell that climbs in sequence, hammering strings and galloping percussion.
palette: Thorns in the Dark v02 string ensemble (violins/viola over pluck, bass, restrained drums)
sections: 1-8: the ember cell rises Fm-Ab-Bbm-C7b9, then falls back through the E dim7
9-16: the cell in sixths; a Neapolitan G-flat blaze before the dominant
17-24: the crown blazes - soaring line over hammering strings (Db-Eb-Fm)
25-32: the cell climbs chromatically Fm-Gbm-Gm-Abm-Am-Bbm to C7, tom rolls
title: Vyraketh, the Cinder Crown
